en: Black‑and‑white wide‑angle view of a very long neoclassical building with a central portico and dome and two similar end pavilions, each with a pediment and smaller dome. A tall flagpole with a U.S. flag stands to the right of the central section. The foreground is an empty, rough dirt field, and there are only faint structures visible far in the distance, suggesting an isolated new public building. The image is framed like an old photographic postcard; some handwriting or numbering appears faintly along the upper edge.
